content: {"praised":["The Beguiled has a tense, sensual atmosphere.","Play Misty for Me is suspenseful with clever subtext.","Eastwood’s early direction shows clear talent.","Coogan’s Bluff is fairly well done.","Remastered visuals make the films look sharp."],"criticized":["Three films are cheesy and comical.","Eiger Sanction is boring and sleep‑inducing.","Coogan’s Bluff features a tool‑like character.","The Beguiled is slow and occasionally sappy."]}
